text: dsh-leafy-skin 是一款适用于 DSH Web GUI 的绿色主题插件，为浅色模式提供翡翠绿配色，为深色模式提供薄荷绿配色。它在网页启动时注入首帧背景样式，并通过主题 token 覆盖调整画布、侧栏、面板、文字、强调色、代码高亮和滚动条等界面颜色。可选样式层还为文本选区、菜单、弹窗、会话切换和交互控件补充配色与动效。适合希望让 DSH 网页界面呈现柔和绿系风格的用户；安装命令见 README，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-leafy-skin themes the DSH Web GUI with emerald light mode and mint dark mode. It overrides colors for surfaces, text, accents, code, and scrollbars, and adds CSS for selections, menus, dialogs, and transitions. Install using the README command; no API keys or external services are needed.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成柔和的绿色主题。
能给 DSH 的浅色和深色模式分别配一套绿系颜色吗？
让 DSH 的网页侧栏、面板和按钮都采用叶绿色调。
我想让界面背景和强调色跟着系统的浅深色设置变化。
有没有办法把 DSH 网页里的蓝灰配色改成统一的绿灰风格？
希望代码块、文字选区和滚动条也能融入绿色主题。
Can I give the DSH web interface a softer green theme in both light and dark mode?
I want the sidebar, panels, and controls in my DSH web app to use leafy colors.
dsh-leafy-skin 的功能「浅深模式绿色调色板」：覆盖 DSH 主题颜色 token，为浅色和深色模式分别提供绿系背景、文字、强调色和组件配色。插件客户端加载时自动应用，并随主题模式切换取对应颜色。
dsh-leafy-skin 的功能「首帧背景染色」：在 Web 页面 index 注入表中加入背景 CSS，使页面脚本运行前和主题状态确定后都能显示匹配的浅绿或深绿画布。插件 Host 侧启动时自动注册该样式。
dsh-leafy-skin 的功能「界面细节样式」：客户端可选注入一层 CSS，为文字选区、交互控件过渡、菜单和弹窗入场、会话内容切换等添加样式。开关 ENABLE_CSS_LAYER 可关闭此层，保留主题 token 覆盖。
dsh-leafy-skin 的功能「启停清理」：客户端将主题 token 覆盖和额外样式分别交给 Cordis effect 管理；样式层在 effect 清理时移除创建的 style 标签，插件卸载或热更新后可撤销注入。

dsh-leafy-skin README · dsh-leafy-skin：An eye-friendly green skin: a leafy palette layered over the official DSH web GUI theme, in a
light emerald and a dark mint variant.

> I wanted the effect of a Minecraft resource pack.

dsh-leafy-skin README · Features：- **Layered greens** — a mist-green canvas, raised panels, and a deeper sidebar, with emerald
  accents in light mode and mint in dark, instead of one flat wash of green.
- **Comfortable by construction** — no pure white or pure black, a single green hue family, and
  all body text at WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1).
- **Texture** — softer corner radii, green-tinted diffuse shadows, low-contrast hairlines, and
  glassy menu surfaces.
- **Details** — mint text selection, Inter / Noto Sans SC / Cascadia Code font stacks, slim
  scrollbars, and restrained hover and menu motion.
- **Tunable** — the palette is one commented table, a self-check script guards contrast, and the
  style layer has a single on/off switch.

dsh-leafy-skin README · Install：```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-leafy-skin
```

Restart DSH once afterwards so the profile recomposes. After that, colour edits only need a page
refresh (client changes hot-reload within about a second).

dsh-leafy-skin README · Usage：Install the plugin and load the app. The skin layers itself over the active theme, so light, dark,
and follow-system each pick up their own variant automatically.

dsh-leafy-skin README · Customize：- **Colours** — the `TOKENS` table in `lib/client.js`, grouped and commented by area.
- **Radii, shadows, fonts, motion** — the same file, plus the small style layer below it.
- **Palette only** — set `ENABLE_CSS_LAYER` to `false` in `lib/client.js` to drop the style layer
  entirely.
- **Check your work** — `node tools/check-palette.mjs` validates token shape, the boot colour
  match, text and syntax contrast (including translucent surfaces and the focus ring), and the
  style layer's three constraints.
- **Coverage matrix** — `node tools/audit-tokens.mjs` reads the installed DSH and lists every
  `--dsw-*` token it declares: whether this skin covers it directly or through a `var()` chain,
  and how often official bundles consume it. `--strict` fails on tokens that are used but covered
  by neither the palette nor a written reason.
- **Stable hooks** — `node tools/check-hooks.mjs` confirms the `data-*` hooks the style layer
  relies on still exist upstream, so a DSH upgrade breaks the check instead of the look.

dsh-leafy-skin README · Known limitations：- The native window title bar belongs to the DSH desktop shell, not to this plugin, so it stays
  DSH grey for the instant before the page paints.
- Real see-through glass is impossible on Windows — the sidebar depth and translucent menus are
  colour layering, not blur through the window.
- Components hard-code font sizes and layout in hashed CSS modules, so this skin deliberately
  leaves them alone.
dsh-leafy-skin README · Contributing：Questions and suggestions are welcome as issues. Pull requests are not accepted.
